summary.text: Ryan Coyne is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windham-3 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran for the same district as an independent in 2020 and 2022 and as a Republican in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Coyne received 1,295 votes (23.0%) as an independent in the 2020 general election for Windham 3, a two-seat district won by Leslie Goldman and Carolyn Partridge.
In 2022 he again ran as an independent and received 346 votes (5.5%).
In 2024 he ran as a Republican and received 1,128 votes (14.6%), behind incumbents Leslie Goldman and Michelle Bos-Lun and independent Casey Cota.
